title: Chapter 973 You Have A Plan
content:
Chapter 973 You Have A Plan

Fenggong Yongchi was a native of Fengyi, Peixian County. He was a famous local tycoon in his hometown, with a rich family fortune and a good reputation as a knight. When the troubled times came, all the counties in Sishui County raised troops to protect themselves. When they heard that Lu Ze killed the county magistrate in Pei County and established himself as Pei Gong, Yong Chi was not to be outdone and raised the flag in Fengyi.

Although this place is called a township, its population is enough to form a county. Yong Chi has more than a thousand children from Feng County under his command. It happened that Peng Yue was attacking Changyi County, and Yong Chi threw himself into his arms. Relying on Peng Yue as his backer, he resisted the annexation of Lu Ze in Pei County. Together with Wang Ling who occupied Xiayi, they formed a tripartite situation in Fengfei.

But as the Chu State became increasingly powerful, and Peng Yue was restricted by Qilu, Yong Chi's wallflower began to move with the wind. Under the lobbying of the Chu people, he surrendered to the Chu State again and was appointed Feng Gong. This time Xiang Liang summoned Huaibei The county officials gathered in Daliang. Because his son was a hostage in Pengcheng, Yong Chi had no choice but to come too.

As a hero, Yong Chi always likes to make friends. This time when the Eighteenth Road County Dukes gathered together, he met many powerful people from various places, including Chen Liu's Li merchants. Chen Liu was close to Daliang and was responsible for part of the army's food. Everyone was interested in it. I hope to have a good relationship with Li Shang.

Therefore, when Li Shang came to visit, Yong Chi Shao had no choice but to greet him in person. He asked his retainers to scrutinize the food and arranged a banquet for several captured folk girls from nearby.

Li Shang did not come alone, he also brought his brother, Wei Dafu Li Shiqi. Li Shiqi did not pretend to be a Confucian scholar here, and called himself "Gaoyang Drunkard". Yong Chi was deeply impressed by the boldness of the drunkenness and found it to his liking.

From that day on, Li Shiqi became a frequent visitor in Yongchi Camp. By the third day, the two of them were so close that they could hide away from everyone and talk quietly...

"There is an abundance of talents."

That day Yong Chi wanted to persuade him to drink, but Li Shiqi stopped him because this old drunkard had a habit of never drinking when discussing important matters, because if he drinks, the other party will easily regret it the next day.

Seeing him, he suddenly felt emotional. Yong Chi was puzzled, but Li Shiqi said:

"Feng Gong is in Fengpei. You should have heard of the term 'Three Heroes of Peixian County'?"

Yong Chi glanced outside and nodded.

"It is said to be that person's statement..."

As an enemy, Hei's name could not be mentioned casually in Chu State, so "that person" was used instead.

"In the past, the chief official of Pei County took care of Xiao He."

The incident of the black man's excess caused a great sensation in the local area.

"The jailer Cao Shen, the rogue son of Fengyi, and the chief of the Sishui Pavilion Liu Ji were all recruited to Jiaodong as officials by that one. They are the three outstanding figures, but..."

Yong Chi showed contempt: "I heard that Xiao He is now the ninth minister in Xianyang, and Cao Shen also controls the military power of a county, with 20,000 to 30,000 people under his command. These two people are indeed from Peixian County in the past hundreds of years. Among the people, the one who has achieved the greatest official status deserves to be called an outstanding person, but who does Liu Ji count?"

As he spoke, he took a sip and said, "You're just a soldier of the Donghai garrison. How dare you be called 'outstanding'?"

Yong Chi had never thought highly of Liu Xiaodi, who had followed him in the past, then ran away to join Wang Ling and Zhang Er, and finally got into the system.

"otherwise."

Li Shiqi shook his head and said: "According to the rumors I heard when I was in Hedong, it was said that the young master Fusu was dead and the Fusu who raised troops in Haidong was just a fake Fusu, a puppet supported by Liu Ji, and that Liu Ji , is the actual controller of the two Liao..."

He smiled and said: "It seems that although Liu Ji has not become the king, he can still be regarded as a prince. He is indeed worthy of the name of the Three Heroes."

"This Liu Ji is really good at maneuvering."

Yong Chi couldn't help but feel a little depressed, and Li Shiqi added: "In addition to the three heroes, Feng Fei also has three heroes. They are Pei Gong Lu Ze, Xia Yi Gong Wang Ling, and Feng Gong you. The three heroes are not as good as the three heroes, but they are different. It is a pity, a pity, a pity to occupy a county and have thousands of troops..."

"What's a pity?"

Li Shiqi smiled and said: "After seeing Duke Feng these days, I just feel that your talents should not be limited to small villages and counties. I think that the so-called three heroes are not necessarily as capable as the three heroes." "Qiang, why can that person enter the court, become a feudal official, or even a prince?"

"Why?"

Li Shiqi began to tell a story about the insights that Li Si, the Prime Minister of the Qin Dynasty, gained from the mouse.

"The virtuous and unworthy of people are like rats. In today's world, not only the king chooses his ministers, but the ministers also choose the king. If you choose the right one, you will skyrocket; if you choose the wrong one, you will be crushed into clay."

"The rat in the barn, because he has chosen the right place, has no worries about food and clothing, and is not afraid of strangers, just like the three heroes. But the rat in the toilet has chosen the wrong place, and is inevitably skinny, cannibalistic, and is afraid of strangers, just like the three heroes. Xia..."

Yong Chi listened attentively, but later he couldn't help but get angry. He slapped the table and said, "You old drunkard, how dare you mock Nai Gong as a rat?"

"Is not it?"

Li Shiqi put away his playful smile and said seriously: "Lü Ze is considered to be one of the best in Peixian County, but now he is detained by Xiang Liang, and his life is in danger. Although Lu Ze was once an enemy of Feng Gong, but seeing his end today, we can't Is there a feeling of sadness for the death of a rabbit and a fox? And it is still unclear whether the Chu State can withstand the attack of the Qin army. In the dead of night, isn't Yong Chi uneasy? "

"What do you want to say?" Yong Chi understood, looked around, and lowered his voice.

Li Shiqi stepped forward and said, "The Kingdom of Chu is bound to perish, and the Xiang family is not qualified to help. The only one who can dominate the world is the regent Xia Gong!"

"Li Shiqi, you want to rebel against Chu!?"

Li Shiqi disagreed: "I am from Wei and have never been loyal to Chu. How can I talk about rebelling against Chu? On the contrary, Duke Feng, as a Chu native, took refuge with Peng Yue. This was to rebel against Chu. He had served as the order of Qi and then defected to Chu again. To rebel against Qi."

"shut up!"

Yong Chi's voice was urgent and short, and he drew his sword at the same time. However, he did not greet Li Shiqi. Instead, he walked to the door and opened a small gap. When he saw no one, he relaxed and turned around and said angrily:

"Whose order are you following to lobby me?"

Li Shiqi stood up slowly, bowed his long teeth towards Yong, and began to formally introduce himself:

"On behalf of the Regent of Da Qin, I would like to express my sincere greetings to the Fourth Hero of Peixian County, Mr. Feng!"

The silence lasted for a long time, and finally there was the sound of the sword being slowly sheathed, and Yong Chi's suppressed excited whisper after sitting down:

"The regent of the Great Qin Dynasty also knows that there are Yong Chis in the world?

…

Also in the same room were Xiang Liang and Zhang Liang, a guest from South Korea...

"In the direction of Nanyang, there are captains and generals stationed in Ye County. In the beginning of spring, they will go north to occupy Kunyang, Wuyang, and Yingxian. They will confront Han Xin (Gongsun Xin) across Ru River... cough cough."

After "liberating" Korea and settling down, Zhang Liang, who had been running around all his life and strong for half his life, suddenly became sickly.

"In the direction of Henan, Chen Ying, the commander of Dongmen Bao, is approaching the Shenyuan Pass. This is the key point of the shortcut from Luoyang to Xu and Zheng. The pass is on the Eling Slope, between Taishi Mountain and Shaoshi Mountain. The road is dangerous and narrow. It is the gate of Korea, and the captain of Han Dynasty is happy to guard it, and it is often in emergency."

Under attack from two sides, since the beginning of spring, Yingchuan has basically been on guard three times a day. Fortunately, Xingyang in the northeast of South Korea and Shangcai in the southeast are still under the control of the Chu State, otherwise Yingchuan would be surrounded.

But even so, Zhang Liang knew very well that with the strength of a Korean county, it could recruit at most 20,000 troops. If the Qin army launched a large-scale attack, the Korean generals would be destroyed overnight.

What's even more troublesome is that South Korea now not only has foreign troubles, but also has internal problems that have been put on hold and unresolved.

Since the death of the former king Han Cheng, the Koreans have never established a king, but the Chu State has arranged a "regent". Xiang Ji asked Zheng Chang, whom he trusted, to sit in Yangzhai and control the military and political power of Korea.

Previously, when Xiang Ji returned to Huainan and tens of thousands of troops passed through Yingchuan, Zheng Chang ordered a large-scale food levy in Han and gave priority to providing food and clothing to the Chu army, which caused widespread complaints among the people. The Chu army's military discipline was very poor, but Zheng Chang was biased.

Even the "comrades" who worked with Zhang Liang to restore the country also expressed doubts about this ambiguous state.

"Is South Korea's restoration of the country successful now? How is it different from the country's subjugation?"

What they want is a Korea where the Koreans make their own decisions, not a puppet of the Chu State, who is squeezed in the war and becomes a victim of the battlefield and ruins...

Xiang Liang promised that he would immediately send people to Yingchuan for support, and he agreed to Zhang Liang's question of supplying food. However, Zhang Liang did not see that he would immediately send people to arrange food transportation.

The situation is imminent, and Yingchuan will become a battlefield. Zhang Liang must find out the Chu people's plans through some method, so that he can decide the next step for South Korea!

He proposed: "South Korea needs a new king, otherwise the Koreans will not be convinced and it will be more difficult to recruit for war."

"Who do you think Zifang can be the King of Han?"

"The country relies on the long-term monarch, Han Xin (Gongsun Xin) may be the king."

But Xiang Liang shook his head: "No, this man can be a general, but not a king."

"I do have a good candidate to be the King of Han."

"Who did Xiang Jun choose?" Zhang Liang sighed. At this juncture, if Xiang Liang still dares to mention Zheng Chang and wants South Korea to make bottomless sacrifices for Chu, then the unequal alliance between Han and Chu will end. It’s the end…

Xiang Liang pointed at Zhang Liang, the Shentu who had restored Korea from scratch, worked hard, and supported it until now:

"You, Zhang Zifang!"
